name: SDN Node Activity Flow
description: M2 node-activity flow (mount GET /api/v1/node/activity): foundation/http-route route_node_activity decides the $HTQ request as an $APR (GET/HEAD -> route activity + the limit clamped [1,256], default 50; anything else STATUS 405); hostcap/node-activity reads the log through the READ-ONLY node_activity_read.activity hostcall (typed $PIV, capability node_activity_read) and answers an $NEV beside the $APR (or STATUS 503); foundation/http-respond respond renders the $HTR: the $NEV verbatim as FlatBuffers by default, JSON on request. Typed contracts 1.0: every edge carries one SDS FlatBuffers type; no JSON travels between nodes (JSON exists only as the client representation http-respond renders on request).

triggers.description: One $HTQ HttpRequest envelope per invocation, pumped by the host at the flow ingress.

api.tagDescription: This node's own recent activity log (wasm; all routing and response shaping run inside the module). Operator-gated (see route anonymous flag) until the $HTQ envelope carries caller-trust information for an anonymous reduced subset.

routes.description: Returns this node's recent event log (newest first, ?limit clamped to [1,256], default 50) as one $NEV (SDS Node Event): peers connecting and leaving, publications sent, records stored, grants issued. Representation: FlatBuffers by default (?format=flatbuffer or Accept: application/x-flatbuffers); ?format=json or Accept: application/json renders the same record as JSON with the standard's IDL field names (enums by name, byte vectors hex) - rendered by foundation/http-respond, the only place JSON exists. No ETag: the log changes on every call. Operator-gated (anonymous:false).

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of activity events to return, newest first. Clamped in-wasm to [1, 256]; defaults to 50 when omitted, empty, non-numeric, zero, negative, or out of range.

200.description: The node's $NEV. Representation: FlatBuffers by default (?format=flatbuffer or Accept: application/x-flatbuffers); ?format=json or Accept: application/json renders the same record as JSON with the standard's IDL field names (enums by name, byte vectors hex) - rendered by foundation/http-respond, the only place JSON exists.

schema.description: $NEV (SDS NEV.fbs): the node event log read
The $NEV as JSON (NODE_ID, GENERATED_AT_MS, EVENTS[{TIME_MS, KIND, PEER_ID, SUBJECT, COUNT, DETAIL}], TOTAL_EVENTS, OLDEST_TIME_MS).
$APR (SDS APR.fbs): the refusal record (STATUS / ERROR_CODE / ERROR_MESSAGE)
$APR (SDS APR.fbs): the refusal record (STATUS / ERROR_CODE / ERROR_MESSAGE)
